newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, but gasoline gains $2.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, but gasoline gains $2.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly steady on Wednesday, but gasoline continued to rise after briefly stalling on Tuesday, dealers said.
Gasoline was around $2 a tonne above Tuesday's close as buyers returned to the market. Bids were around $236 fob ARA and offers at $238. No early deals were reported.
Heating oil barges were flat to 50 cents higher in line with August IPE gas oil futures. Premiums for prompt and second half August deliveries held at IPE August +$1/+$1.25 fob Rotterdam.
The dollar again moved higher against the mark, pushing past DM1.88, further discouraging German buyers.
High sulphur fuel oil barges opened unchanged from Tuesday's close, valued at around $96 fob Rotterdam, but with little buying interest.
